summary: page a long list with an opaque cursor safe against inserts
use_when: an API lists rows by time and id and must not repeat or skip one as rows change
a client needs an opaque next-page token to hand back to the client
not_for: jumping to page N or counting all rows: a cursor only moves forward from the last row seen
a secret or signed cursor: anyone can decode or forge one, so enforce access in the query
